claim_groups.finding: The saved preview and mesh inputs explicitly limit scope to geometry-only; wall, curvature, solver and physical qualification are excluded.
0.5 mm is OCC linear deflection and 0.2 rad angular tolerance, not max edge or tetra spacing; max triangle edge is not recorded.
No tetra mesh is part of the declared preview.
No wall qualification; radial meridian declarations are explicit; high-curvature/extreme parameter CAD qualification remains untested.
Three mesh summaries report zero boundary/nonmanifold/vertex-collapsed triangles and watertight edge incidence; boundary loops are not separately counted.
No duplicate-face, area, local orientation, mesh self-intersection or mesh connected-component metrics; OCC shell count is present.
OCC and mesh signed volumes and <1% relative deltas are stored for all three defaults.
Surface area, centroid and inertia errors are not measured.
Preview supports qualitative faceting/gradation observations, but aspect ratio and local mesh error are not quantified.
Three analytic profiles are axisymmetric single-meridian forms; training shortcut is only conditional because no training dataset evidence exists.
Every profile call has finite/range/simple-section checks, but OCC was only built for three defaults; v2 narrow-mouth jar has no OCC evidence.
Wall and base declarations are separate parameters with coupled constraints; no global minimum wall or dedicated realistic reinforcement model is promised.
Three paint fields have zero relief by contract; one +0.65 mm raised ring explains the plot difference; code separates channels/effects.
Plot has no engraving input and only one positive raised band; v2 has a negative scalar-field numerical test, not a 3D test.
Stacking formulas and per-layer masks are present; the image omits layer diagnostics and exact overlapping-output tests are limited.
No gradient/Hessian/cusp or total relief report; no stack-level geometry/wall gate and no 3D output.
Nearest-neighbor raster edges do not prove discontinuous example fields; zero softness is allowed in the general API and can produce hard scalar boundaries.
Cylindrical theta/z coordinates lack surface metric correction; this matters if constant physical surface spacing is required.
Value seam tested for all three field families; gradients and mesh seam are not tested; no seam failure is evidenced.
Current deterministic patterns are regular; real-world variation and dataset domain-gap testing are absent, but no training outcome is known.
No ornament-to-CAD/mesh integration; resulting 3D watertightness, wall penetration and remesh retention cannot yet be evaluated.
Reference catalog is an index, not a qualified measured sample set; no real-vs-synthetic distribution comparison is present.
Figures have no metric overlay, but separate mesh JSON and saved test receipts contain scoped measurements/results; ornament physical metrics remain absent.
PG-Frag and cross-system completion semantics are outside this review; local geometry-only and height-field statuses are explicit.
No scoped production bridge/common artifact ID; standalone hashes exist; end-to-end stale-artifact invalidation is not evidenced.
